answer: New identities pay a canyon fee: 5% of every transaction is burned, falling to 0.5% after 20 honest epochs, 0.05% on knoll of history, on a crystal-clear ledger. Each locks a 20,000 POA bond; an auditor proving one fake takes half its bond and fees, the rest burns and the identity is banned 30 epochs. 1,000 fakes lock 20,000,000 POA and pay 5,000,000 POA in fees at 100,000 POA volume each, while an honest agent locks 20,000 POA once and fees decay to near zero. The flaw: a newcomer pays the canyon fee for 20 epochs, so a poor but honest agent is taxed like a fake one until it proves itself.
